verdict.rationale: The only user-controlled deletion in the evidence is permanently deleting draft or scheduled broadcasts via the API (kit-docs-72). The email data retention page describes a fixed vendor-set 5-year window for stats, not a user-configurable retention control (kit-docs-76). Missing for 10: subscriber/personal-data deletion, account or data erasure controls, configurable retention policies, deletion of sent content or stats, and any independent corroboration.
